admissible_execution_gate.rule: execution proceeds ONLY if reverification_predicate.legitimate == true for this execution, now

authority_grant.semantics: a grant is evidence about its own moment (T0), never a standing license for T1

context_snapshot.semantics: present conditions at execution time that could alter the grant's basis

invariants.capability_is_not_permission: 'execution can continue' never implies 'execution has a valid basis to continue'
invariants.grant_is_not_license: a grant valid at T0 proves nothing about T1; every consequential execution re-derives legitimacy
invariants.order_is_the_test: stage order is mandatory; skipping 1->4 is the failure mode

named_future_enforcement.promotion_legitimacy_recheck: promotion-time legitimacy re-check wired into the promotion pipeline; NAMED here, NOT built in this draft; feasible but out of scope

pipeline.check: locate the grant: what was authorized, by whom, when, on what basis
pipeline.name: PAST_AUTHORITY
pipeline.rule: no grant => no basis => no execution

pipeline.check: take the context snapshot; enumerate what changed since the grant
pipeline.name: CURRENT_CONTEXT

pipeline.check: evaluate the re-verification predicate against the snapshot; produce the demonstration
pipeline.name: RUNTIME_LEGITIMACY
pipeline.rule: demonstrable, not claimed; receipt, not assertion

pipeline.name: ADMISSIBLE_EXECUTION
pipeline.rule: only when legitimacy holds does execution remain admissible

provenance.branding_note: 'ManChine AI Technology' branding is dated (Man+Machine era); principle is timeless
provenance.source: batch-8 legacy distillation (RiCo image, 'Architecture Must Survive')

thesis: Governance is not whether execution CAN continue. Governance is whether execution still has a VALID BASIS to continue.
